## Assessment Conclusion

The three source documents provide sufficient material for a coherent level-zero enterprise vision. The target vision has consolidated the common mission, principles, domain model, Zero Trust direction, AI direction, artifact hierarchy, governance expectations, and success criteria. The remaining risk is propagation: downstream artifacts must consistently identify the target vision or an explicitly subordinate domain vision, and the formal architecture review and publication decision must be recorded.
